title: </sub>  Avoid cancelling same-SHA review runs
text:
</sub>  Avoid cancelling same-SHA review runs

When a pull request is closed and quickly reopened while its initial review is still running, the `reopened` event retains the same head SHA but enters this concurrency group and cancels the first run. If cancellation occurs after `publishReview` succeeds but before the terminal `Ronda review` check is created, the replacement run finds no existing check and posts a second review for that SHA. Restrict cancellation to events that introduce a new head SHA or add cancellation-safe in-flight deduplication to preserve the repository's one-review-per-SHA contract.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L11-L13](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/456dfeb4d9d21add669b8b8fd063927de4aceb11/AGENTS.md#L11-L13)
